title: Pace curves use distance and values arrays
body: A plausible frontend fixture used distances and secs, but the real Intervals pace-curves endpoint returns distance and values. Values are elapsed seconds for the corresponding distance in metres, not speed. The incorrect normalizer silently produced an empty running curve even though 94 points were available. Aggregate pace curves remain available even when individual Strava-source activities are API-restricted.
resolution: Accept actual distance/values arrays and convert to seconds/km as values[i]*1000/distance[i]. Added an explicit upstream-contract regression test; no personal curve values committed.
